summary: Iranian forces and proxies escalated cross-border attacks across the Middle East, including strikes on Saudi Arabia and Iraq, while the Houthis claimed responsibility for drone and missile attacks. The Yemeni Army reported targeting Saudi weapons depots in Sharurah using ballistic missiles and drones. Lebanese Hezbollah and Israeli forces exchanged fire across the border, with ongoing artillery and airstrikes reported.
key_points: Yemeni Army struck Saudi weapons depots in Sharurah with ballistic missiles and drones, per official spokesman. (Source: @presstv/206554)
Houthis claimed 129 Saudi-led airstrikes hit seven Yemeni provinces over 48 hours, vowing retaliation. (Source: @kianmeli1/91862)
Iraqi PM approved Iranian request for joint investigation into drone launch sites near Iraq-Iran border linked to Saudi attacks. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7089)
Lebanon recorded 179 alerts including 116 drone detections and 10 airstrikes, mostly in border villages. (Source: @redlinkleb/42571)
Unverified reports cited air defense activation in Shiraz and Tehran, possibly Iranian launches or interception attempts. (Source: @New_security8200/203779)
Iranian Guard commander met with army chief amid speculation over potential Israeli assassination attempts. (Source: @kianmeli1/91869)
Explosions heard on Qeshm Island in southern Iran, with no immediate cause identified. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80781)

sections.threat_assessment: The region faces heightened risk of escalation as Iranian-backed groups conduct cross-border strikes against Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Lebanon. The Houthis' claim of 129 airstrikes and vow for retaliation signals sustained momentum in Yemen. Unverified air defense activations in Iran suggest potential for miscalculation. Joint investigations between Iran and Iraq may deepen proxy coordination. Continued drone and missile activity threatens broader regional destabilization.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia and the UAE are responding to Houthi attacks with defensive measures and diplomatic engagement. Iraq is balancing Iranian influence with counter-terrorism commitments. Lebanon remains on high alert following increased Hezbollah-Israel tensions. The U.S. maintains ISR presence in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf. BRICS diplomacy offers limited leverage amid ongoing hostilities.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian military leadership continues coordination with regional proxies despite internal security concerns. Satellite imagery confirms operational readiness of Iranian air defense systems. Cross-border drone activity indicates advanced planning and logistics. Unverified reports require corroboration before actionable intelligence can be confirmed. Regional actors are adjusting postures in anticipation of further escalation.
